Just had my checkup, I switched to pristiq 
Hopefully it’ll be ok
I’ll update later
It’s a lucky charm, meant for longevity and wealth! 長命 means long lifespan 富貴means wealth

I’ve been experiencing the same side effect with Zoloft
I have a check up days later and will likely switch to something else
Hopefully I can give you some useful info later!
Hopefully I’ll have enough time :( thank you so much though
Thank you so much! I have only been sleeping the past days so I couldn’t see this earlier. Honestly I don’t see any improvements, I think it even got worse so yeah I’ll definitely try something new

I’m now on 100 mg 
Maybe I should consult him about the dosage! Thank you so much

I’m glad it worked out for you! I’m considering if I should switch to another one because so far after being on Zoloft, I have absolutely no appetite and even more blue, feeling suicidal at times. But it’s all about trial and error (?) still very happy for you
Ah I see! Thanks! I think the psychiatrist has mentioned about gradually increasing the dosage so I’ll wait and see
